name: On-demand work-at-home contact centre agent (Working Solutions)
summary: Working Solutions contracts independent agents in the US and Canada to handle customer calls for client programs from home, paid per productive minute.
whatYouDo: You certify for a client program (e.g. customer care, sales or benefits enrollment), book available time slots, and handle customer contacts from home. You are paid only for productive minutes and invoice as an independent contractor.
appeal: Official pages say Canadian applicants are accepted
Program classes/certifications are free; possible education stipend after minimum hours
watchOuts: Paid per productive minute ($0.25–$0.31/min ≈ $15–$18.60/hr only while productive); currency/Canadian rates not confirmed
Independent contractor: no benefits; you handle your own taxes
Reviewers report limited available hours, competition for slots and a 20-hour weekly minimum on some programs
One reviewer says ~2 weeks of training time was unpaid (another says paid)
Complaint-site reports (unverified) of disputed final payments; province rules not stated

training.notes: Official FAQ: classes/certifications at no cost; stipend possible after minimum authorized hours. Reviewers disagree on whether training time is paid.

compensation.notes: Derived from official FAQ rate of $0.25–$0.31 per productive minute (x60). Only productive minutes paid; currency not stated in what was seen (US-based company).

reliability.notes: Reviewers report limited hours and competition among contractors; work depends on client program demand.

fees: No certification fee per official FAQ; payment by no-fee direct deposit or debit card. As a contractor you cover your own taxes.
applicationSteps: Apply on jobs.workingsolutions.com and confirm your Canadian location is accepted
Choose a client program and complete its free certification
Book available time slots and start taking contacts
Track productive minutes and set aside tax (no employer deductions)
fitsIf: You want self-scheduled phone work from home and can accept contractor status and uneven hours.
notFitIf: You need a guaranteed paycheque, benefits, or pay for idle time between calls.
